name: PDF Editor
idea: All-in-one PDF editor: add/edit text boxes, highlight, draw, shapes, images, sign, fill forms, reorder/rotate/delete pages, merge, export. pdf.js to render, pdf-lib to write.

name: Budget
idea: Envelope budgeting: accounts, categories, monthly assign/spend/available, transactions, CSV import from bank exports, recurring items, reports chart, multi-currency incl. JOD, export/import backup file.

name: Diagrams
idea: Flowcharts and diagrams: shape library, connectors that follow shapes, snapping, text, colours, layers, templates (flowchart, org chart, ER), export PNG/SVG/PDF, save file.

name: Time Tracker
idea: Start/stop timers per project and client, manual entries, tags, billable rates, weekly timesheet, reports with charts, invoice-ready CSV/PDF export.

name: Gantt
idea: Gantt chart planner: tasks, durations, dependencies (drag to link), milestones, progress, critical path, zoom day/week/month, export PNG/PDF/CSV, import CSV.

name: Base
idea: Tables with typed fields (text, number, select, date, checkbox, link to another table, attachment as local file), grid/kanban/calendar/gallery views, filters, sorts, CSV import/export.

name: Mind Map
idea: Keyboard-first mind maps: Tab child, Enter sibling, drag to reorganise, collapse, colours, icons, auto layout, export PNG/SVG/PDF/Markdown outline, import outline.

name: Link Page
idea: Build a link-in-bio page: themes, buttons, socials, avatar, live phone preview; exports a single self-contained HTML file plus a QR code, with step-by-step free hosting instructions.

name: PDF Notes
idea: Handwrite and annotate on PDFs and blank notebooks: pen/highlighter/eraser with pressure, lasso move, paper templates, notebooks library saved in IndexedDB, export annotated PDF. Great for students.

name: Email Builder
idea: Drag-and-drop email template builder: blocks (text, image, button, columns, divider, social), mobile preview, exports email-safe HTML (tables, inline styles) to paste into any mail tool.

name: CRM
idea: Small-business CRM: contacts, companies, deal pipeline board with stages and values, tasks and reminders, notes timeline, CSV import/export, dashboard totals. All local.

name: Beat Maker
idea: Step sequencer and pattern-based beat maker: synthesized drum kit (WebAudio, no samples needed), synth bass/lead with piano roll, tempo/swing, song arrangement, export WAV.

name: Subtitle Editor
idea: Load a video, edit subtitle lines on a timeline synced to playback, styles, import/export SRT/VTT, burn-in export via canvas + MediaRecorder.

name: Floor Plan
idea: 2D floor plans: draw walls with lengths, doors, windows, furniture library, room areas in m2 auto-calculated, export PNG/PDF at scale.

name: Logo Maker
idea: Logo generator: name + industry → many layouts from bundled fonts and SVG icon set, edit colours/spacing, export SVG/PNG and a mini brand kit sheet.

name: Teleprompter
idea: Teleprompter with smooth scroll speed, mirror mode, font size, countdown, remote control via keyboard, optional camera recording with the script overlaid.

name: Storyboard
idea: Storyboards: frames grid with sketch/upload image, shot type, action and dialogue, reorder, animatic playback with timing, export PDF.

name: Study Planner
idea: Timetable, subjects, lectures and exams, auto-built revision plan to the exam date, progress ticks, pomodoro link, Arabic/English.
